name: Naraka
source:
A member of the Bad Apples. A first glance looks like a goth lolita... but he's actually a crossdressing boy. He's good at handicrafts and he designs and makes most of the Bad Apples' clothes. He came to the school in search of "handicrafts".

[From [url=http://www.otomate.jp/baw/chara/]Official site[/url]]
